description: Archive-then-delete a single wiki page. On confirm=true, writes a recoverable archived_pages row (origin path/folder, content, metadata, deleted_by, optional reason) before deleting from live storage/index. Set confirm=false (default) for a dry-run preview. Protected system pages (instructions/brain-routing.md, decisions/readme.md, history/readme.md, log.md, index.md) cannot be deleted.
name: delete_page
